articles.title: Milei recibió a la cúpula global de Bayer en medio del debate por las patentes de medicamentos y la propiedad intelectual
articles.summary: President Milei met with Bayer executives at Casa Rosada to discuss intellectual property protection, patent frameworks, and regulatory policies for pharmaceutical innovation in Argentina.

articles.title: El efusivo canto de la Marcha de San Lorenzo que hizo Javier Milei junto a un granadero
articles.summary: President Milei participated in the July 9 Independence Day Te Deum at the Metropolitan Cathedral and sang the San Lorenzo March with cavalry officers during the official ceremony.

articles.title: Desde Tucumán, Milei llamó a los gobernadores a 'sentar las bases para el futuro de una verdadera libertad'
articles.summary: During the July 9 Independence Day vigil in Tucumán, President Milei reviewed his administration's two-year record and outlined legislative priorities including Central Bank reform, fiscal zones, and political reforms.

articles.title: Ahora juega la casta: Javier Milei movió primero y fuerte para 2027
articles.summary: The government is preparing for Milei's 2027 reelection campaign, working on eliminating the primary election system (PASO), building political alliances with governors, and strengthening party organization.

articles.title: Javier Milei puso la Casa Rosada a disposición de la Selección y prometió no estar presente el día que la visiten
articles.summary: President Milei offered Casa Rosada for Argentina's national soccer team to celebrate if they win the World Cup, stating he would not be present to avoid political interference in their achievement.
